problem.statement_latex: Given a known finite group $G=A\rtimes B$ from the families in Bacon--Childs--van Dam and an oracle constant and distinct on left cosets of a hidden subgroup $H$, output generators of $H$. Families include specified metacyclic groups and $(\mathbb Z_p)^r\rtimes\mathbb Z_p$ for fixed $r$.
problem.statement_text: Given a known finite group $G=A\rtimes B$ from the families in Bacon–Childs–van Dam and an oracle constant and distinct on left cosets of a hidden subgroup $H$, output generators of $H$. Families include specified metacyclic groups and $(\mathbb Z_p)^r\rtimes\mathbb Z_p$ for fixed $r$.
